t: Multi-spray gun with 5 spray patterns. Features smooth flow control for a quick change of water flow. Choose the exact amount of water needed by adjusting between a high power jet for cleaning or gentle watering for flowers. Front trigger, ergonomic on/off lock button and flow control have all been located so they can be easily operated with just one hand giving instant access to all the features needed. Comes with a quick connect male connector which enables a fast changing between attachments.
